chapter.heading: Psalm 6
O LORD, Deliver My Life
To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments; according to The Sheminith.(1) A Psalm of David.
chapter.v: heal me , O Lord ,for my bones are troubled .
save me for the sake of your steadfast love .
in Sheol who will give you praise ?
I drench my couch with my weeping .
it grows weak because of all my foes .
for the Lordhas heard the sound of my weeping .
they shallturn back and be put to shame in a moment .

footnotes.footnote: 6:1 Probably a musical or liturgical term
